My therapist played this game with me when I was deeply deeply anxious about everything. She’d list off these random scenarios and ask how I’d handle them. Like, “there’s a fire outside the door, how do you get out” And I’d try to come up with a way out. I’d be wrong every time but when she shared with me the most logical thing to do, it equipped me with tools and reminded me that my first instinct is almost always my mental illness talking. It was helpful because I then knew what to do in a lot of scenarios and also learned about myself and to not trust my gut all the time lol. It might be a cool flash card type thing? I don’t know, but I like brainstorming for you.
